label: Aksjesparekonto (ASK)
Ange vinstdelen av tidigare uttag före å: Enter the gain portion of previous withdrawals before this year’s shielding allowance, excluding returned contributions. The annual calculation deducts the available allowance once. Enter remaining contributed capital separately under tax basis.
Norge 2026: tillskjutet kapital tas ut f: Norway 2026: contributed capital is withdrawn first, then the shielding allowance is used. Losses are deductible only on explicit closure. The 2026 shielding rate is set after year end and is not yet known; enter a forecast assumption, even if choosing 0%. The 2025 rate of 3.6% is not a confirmed rate for 2026.
Årets hittills lägsta tillskjutna kapita: Lowest contributed capital year to date (NO ASK)
Ange årets hittills lägsta återstående t: Enter the lowest remaining contributed capital year to date for shielding.
Ange en antagen skjermingsränta mellan 0: Enter an assumed shielding rate between 0% and 100% for the forecast (0% is an explicit choice, even for an empty account).
2026 års officiella skjermingsränta är ä: The official 2026 shielding rate has not yet been published. Enter your own assumption even for an empty account that may receive future deposits; 0% must also be selected explicitly.
